# BrushableHistogram

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Interactive histogram with brushable range selection for data filtering. Drag handles to select a range, keyframe brush positions for animation.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/brushable-histogram",
  "type": "BrushableHistogramOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/brushable-histogram').par.data` (an input) and `op('/brushable-histogram').out.filteredData` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.filteredData`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `DataField` | `[]` |
| `field` | `StringLiteralField` | `""` |
| `binCount` | `NumberField` | `20` |
